svg.title: Open Source Metro, vintage light: annual contribution-calendar-inspired event map
svg.desc: Synthetic demo. A fifty-three-week, seven-day contribution-style grid displays ONLY source-observed event units, not a complete GitHub contributions history. Five coloured metro services trace recorded event types in chronological UTC order. Repo station names appear below the map.
svg.text: A CONTRIBUTION CALENDAR REIMAGINED AS A TRANSIT NETWORK
UTC • SUN → SAT • SNAPSHOT EVENTS ONLY
